evals.prompt: Prepare this Skill tree as a public Codex Plugin GA release, but the license is still proprietary preview and no model eval has run.
evals.expected_output: Blocks GA, permits only an accurately labelled internal RC if static gates pass, and lists license and real-model evaluation as blockers.
expectations: Does not call the package GA
Separates RC readiness from GA readiness
Requires license decision and real-model evidence

evals.prompt: The plugin content changed but the manifest version is unchanged. Create the release.
evals.expected_output: Requires a version bump before packaging and explains cache/update risk.

evals.prompt: Create a local marketplace package for this skills-only plugin.
evals.expected_output: Creates .agents/plugins/marketplace.json pointing to ./plugins/<name>, a plugin with .codex-plugin/plugin.json and skills/, and validates both.
expectations: Does not add apps or MCP fields without companion manifests
